packs.title: Art, Racing and Outdoors
packs.promise: Explore Charlotte through art, science, racing heritage and open-air adventures.

q.s: Give a science question some evidence.
st: Choose an available exhibit and read its instructions.
Find two observable details that relate to its explanation.
Write what you noticed and one question that could be explored next.

q.s: Respond to the way an artist or designer uses a material.
st: Choose an artwork or design object in an open gallery.
Credit its maker and title, then note a material stated by the label.
Make an original sketch or written idea that imagines a different use for that material.

q.s: Carry forward the artist’s name and the context presented with the work.
st: Visit an available exhibition and choose one artwork.
Record the artist, title and one contextual fact from its interpretation in your own words.
Add a question you want to explore further, keeping it separate from the stated fact.

packs.title: Patterns along Tryon
packs.promise: Follow small fronts, public art and park spaces through South Tryon.

q.s: Make a tiny collage without taking anything.
st: Choose an open path outside events and planted beds.
Pick a ground shape, a growing shape and a patch of sky.
Draw three separate pieces on your page and rearrange them into a small imaginary landscape.
Observe from the public sidewalk without climbing entrance steps.
Find a broad wall plane, a repeated division and a smaller contrasting detail.
Record three short visual beats, from largest to smallest.

q.s: Find three ways a facade joins its parts.
st: Stay on the public sidewalk outside doors and vehicle ramps.
Find a panel, a diagonal seam and a window or open-looking division.
Describe how the parts create a larger pattern; no interior view is needed.
